body:
The icon/logo purple (#863BFF) isn't the app's Material color scheme — buttons,
chips, accents use the default palette. Seed light/dark color schemes from the
brand purple (and check whether dynamicColor is enabled — it would override the
brand on Android 12+; prefer the brand). Optionally set the themed splash/window
background to the icon's lavender (#EDE6FF) for a coherent launch.
title: Brand-align the app theme: seed Material colors from the brand purple
